description:

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Accounts Assistant to join an established international business based in Aylesbury.
Reporting to the number one of Finance , you'll play an important role in the day-to-day running of the finance function, with exposure across purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control, banking and month-end.

Your new role
Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing supplier invoices and payments
- Reconciling supplier statements and intercompany accounts
- Managing supplier queries and maintaining accurate account records
- Processing expenses and supporting accruals and prepayments
- Issuing customer statements and following up outstanding balances
- Resolving customer payment and pricing queries
- Raising invoices and credit notes
- Completing monthly bank reconciliations
- Reconciling retail sales, card payments, settlements and associated fees
- Supporting month-end reporting and audit requirements
- Assisting the Finance Manager with ad hoc projects and process improvements

What you'll need to succeed
You'll be an experienced finance professional with a strong eye for detail, a methodical approach and a genuine problem-solving mindset.
Ideally, you'll have worked in a similar hands-on finance role, with the confidence to investigate discrepancies, resolve complex queries and see issues through to completion.You'll ideally bring:
- Experience across purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control and account reconciliations
- Experience investigating and resolving complex financial queries
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail
- A proactive, analytical and problem-solving approach
- Good Excel skills and previous experience using accounting software
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
- Confidence communicating with suppliers, customers and colleagues
- The ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a wider team

An AAT qualification or equivalent would be beneficial but is not essential.
You'll also have an interest in developing your systems knowledge and embracing new technology, including the appropriate use of AI tools to support financial processes and improve efficiency.
What you'll get in return
This is a great opportunity if you're looking for a role that offers more variety and responsibility than a traditional transactional finance position.You'll gain exposure across several areas of the finance function while working closely with the Finance Manager within an established international business.The package includes:
- £35,000-£38,000 depending on experience

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Looking to broaden your accounting experience, work closely with senior finance leadership and take the next step in your finance career? This is an excellent opportunity to join an established international technology business offering a varied role, a collaborative working environment and support towards your AAT qualification.

Robert Half is partnering with this business to recruit a Finance Assistant for its team in High Wycombe. With operations spanning the UK, US and Australia, you'll gain exposure to international finance activities and a broad range of accounting responsibilities.

Reporting directly to the Finance Director and working alongside another Finance Assistant, you'll contribute to the smooth running of the finance function, develop your technical skills and help improve financial processes across the business.

The Role

You'll play an important part in the day-to-day running of the finance function, with responsibilities including:
- Management Accounts: Supporting the preparation and analysis of monthly management accounts.
- Month-End Reporting: Assisting with the monthly close process, preparing journals and ensuring the general ledger is accurate.
- Balance Sheet Reconciliations: Preparing supporting schedules and completing reconciliations to maintain the integrity of financial records.
- Financial Analysis: Producing and analysing weekly bookings, billings and backlog reports, alongside sales and cash reporting.
- Cost Control: Supporting the monitoring and management of overhead expenditure.
- VAT & GST: Assisting with quarterly VAT and GST returns and supporting import-related accounting requirements.
- Audit Support: Providing information and documentation for internal and external audits.
- Transactional Finance: Providing cover across accounts payable and accounts receivable when required.
- Systems & Processes: Maintaining exchange rates within SAP Business One and identifying opportunities to improve processes, reporting and functionality.
- Wider Finance Support: Assisting the Finance Director and finance team with additional accounting activities as needed.

You'll work collaboratively with the other Finance Assistant to share knowledge, coordinate responsibilities and ensure the finance function runs smoothly across the business's international entities.

About You

We're looking for someone with a positive, proactive approach who enjoys working as part of a team and is keen to develop their accounting expertise.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a finance or accounting role, with exposure to management accounts and month-end processes.
- A good understanding of general ledger accounting, journals and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Strong Excel skills and confidence using financial systems.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
- Good communication and organisational skills, with a collaborative approach to working.
- An interest in improving processes and developing your technical capabilities.

Experience with SAP Business One and Concur would be advantageous, as would exposure to multi-entity accounting and VAT/GST. AAT studies, whether completed or in progress, would be beneficial, although a willingness to learn and develop is equally important.

What's on Offer?
- Salary up to £35,000, with AAT study support.
- Broad accounting exposure: Develop your experience across management accounts, reporting, reconciliations and transactional finance.
- Direct access to senior leadership: Work closely with the Finance Director and gain insight into the wider finance function.
- International experience: Support financial activities across the UK, US and Australia.
- A collaborative team: Join a finance team where you can share responsibilities, learn from colleagues and contribute ideas.
- Process improvement: Have the opportunity to suggest improvements and help make the finance function more efficient.

If you're looking for a varied Finance Assistant role where you can build your technical knowledge, gain international exposure and develop your career within a supportive team, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today through Robert Half to find out more.

Robert Half Ltd acts as an employment business for temporary positions and an employment agency for permanent positions. Robert Half is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. title: Accounts Payable Assistant
description:
Role Overview

The Accounts Payable Assistant is a core member of the finance team, responsible for ensuring the accurate, efficient, and timely processing of high-volume supplier invoices and employee expenses. Based in our Milton Keynes office, this permanent role focuses on maintaining a precise purchase ledger, resolving financial queries, and facilitating weekly payment runs while ensuring strict adherence to internal financial controls.

Key Responsibilities

Invoice Processing & Ledger Management
- Accurately log, match, batch, and code high volumes of purchase invoices against corresponding purchase orders (POs) and delivery notes.
- Ensure all invoices are authorized by the appropriate department heads prior to payment.
- Maintain a clean, up-to-date, and accurate purchase ledger.
- Identify and investigate discrepancies between POs, delivery receipts, and supplier invoices.

Payment Runs & Reconciliations
- Prepare and process weekly and mid-month payment runs (BACS, CHAPS, and international transfers) accurately and on time.
- Perform regular supplier statement reconciliations, actively chasing missing invoices or credit notes to ensure account balances align.
- Process and reconcile employee out-of-pocket expenses and corporate credit card statements in line with company policy.
- Assist with month-end and year-end closing procedures, ensuring all AP timelines are met.

Query Resolution & Supplier Relations
- Serve as the primary point of contact for external supplier inquiries via phone and email, resolving payment disputes and account holds professionally.
- Liaise internally with procurement and operational teams to resolve unapproved invoices and PO discrepancies.
- Set up new supplier accounts and maintain accurate vendor master data, ensuring bank details are verified to prevent fraud.

Experience & Knowledge
- Proven track record working within an Accounts Payable, Purchase Ledger, or general Finance Administration role.
- Strong understanding of standard double-entry bookkeeping and basic accounting principles.
- Familiarity with major ERP or accounting software (e.g., SAP, Sage, Oracle, Xero, or MS Dynamics).
- Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, and basic formulas).

Skills & Attributes
- Attention to Detail: Exceptional numerical accuracy and a meticulous approach to data entry.
- Time Management: Ability to manage a fast-paced workload, prioritize effectively, and meet strict daily and monthly deadlines.
- Communication: Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills for handling internal stakeholders and external suppliers.
- Reliability: A strong sense of accountability and comfort working fully on-site in a structured 9-to-5 team environment.

Compensation & Benefits
- Salary: 30,000 - 32,000
- Pension: Company pension scheme with employer contributions
- Holiday: 25 days annual leave plus standard UK bank holidays

title: Corporate Credit Controller
description:
Corporate Credit Controller - permanent
£30,000 - £32,000 (depending on experience)
Hybrid working - 2 days in the office, 3 at home

High Wycombe location (near public transport routes and free parking and modern offices)

UK residents only. We cannot assist with overseas applications or VISA assistance.

Gleeson Recruitment Group are working very closely with one of the most well-established, multi-site clients in the UK, who have over 250 sites throughout the UK. Their centralised finance function sits in very modern offices in Buckinghamshire and they require a Corporate Credit Controller, to join their friendly, team-spirited team.

My client can offer training on their in-house systems, to the successful Corporate Credit Controller, but this role is ideally geared to those with existing credit control experience, looking after Corporate accounts. You ideally will have held similar roles within a team environment previously, and if you are able to hit the ground running with limited training, then this would be preferred.

Based in their central collections team in their modern High Wycombe Offices, the Credit Controller will be responsible for your own portfolio of customer accounts of around 200-300 live accounts, of a recently acquired business, and you will undertake the following duties, whilst working in an experienced team, reporting to the Credit Supervisor:
- To pro-actively chase an assigned portfolio to ensure payment to terms and maximise collections in order to achieve monthly and quarterly targets. This will mainly be email chasing of Corporate Accounts, with most clients working from home

-Communicate with customers on a daily basis, via email and call to ensure prompt payment of outstanding invoices and maximise cash collected
- Focus on maintaining and developing excellent relationships with customers and resolving any queries accordingly in an efficient and effective manner
- Daily use of customer portals to ensure all overdue accounts are fully tracked with all notes/cash received
- Resolving queries, as many of the customers are on Direct Debit so many queries need to be handled throughout the month
- Raise credit notes and re-issue invoices as and when required
- Maintain detailed notes on all accounts, and up-date all relevant systems with the status of all outstanding invoices

This is a challenging, fast-paced Corporate Credit Controller position, and requires the individual to be extremely team-focused, and be able to multi-task with ease, and work effectively with all internal colleagues, account managers, sales staff and admin staff at all times. The ability to work under pressure is essential.

Please contact me for further information of this superb Corporate Credit Controller opportunity, where my client can offer superb, modern offices, free parking and a great working environment. You will be working from home 3 days a week and in the office 2 days per week, also with long term career opportunities available also.

Essential

Previous experience in a Credit Control, Sales Ledger or Accounts Receivable role.

Experience of allocating customer receipts and maintaining customer accounts.

Good understanding of aged debtors, payment terms and credit control processes.

Good Excel skills.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Confident communicating with customers and colleagues at different levels of the business.

Able to organise and prioritise workload independently.

Desirable

Experience working within a manufacturing, engineering or distribution environment.

Experience using Sage 200 or a similar accounting/ERP system.

Experience carrying out customer credit checks and monitoring credit limits.

Experience supporting month-end finance processes.

Personal Approach

We are looking for someone who is:
- Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of the debtor ledger.
- Confident but professional when chasing outstanding debt.
- Organised and methodical.
- Commercially aware and able to balance debt collection with maintaining good customer relationships.
